}}{{TIDTOC|adapter}} ==Overview== {{See also|MediaTek reference design}} {{#set:Probable Linux driver=mt76}} ===Features=== :;Platform *32bit RISC-V MCU for Wi-Fi protocol and Wi-Fi offload *PCIe 3.0 interface with 2-lane, Embedded SRAM and ROM :;WLAN *802.11abgn/ac/ax/be compliant *Frequency band: 2.4GHz - Bandwidth: 20/40MHz (2T2R 2ss) *Frequency band: 5GHz - Bandwidth: 20/40/80/160MHz (3T3R 2ss) *Data rate: of up to 688Mbps for 40MHz channel in 2.4GHz and :4323Mbps for 160MHz in 5GHz mode *Dual-Band Dual Concurrent (DBDC), Supports up to 4096-QAM *Integrated power detector to support per packet Tx power control *Multi-user multiple input multiple output (MU-MIMO) for Tx and Rx *Multi-user Orthogonal Frequency-Division Multiple Access (MU-OFDMA) *Support STBC, LDPC, Tx beamformer and Rx beamformee *Support greenfield mode, mixed mode, and legacy mode :;Security *WPA3, WPA2, WPA personal, WPS 2.0 :;QoS *WFA WMM and WMM-PS
